eval_plan: Sweep K in {8,24,48,80,120} clauses under clang++ -std=c++17 -O2 monolithic vs B=8 partitioned.
hypothesis: Boost.Proto crv_constraint C++17 clang++ -O2 compile time scales superlinearly (~O(K^1.6-2.1)) beyond K=35-50 clauses; partitioning into B=8 sub-constraints cuts compile latency >3x with identical Z3 QF_BV semantics.
measured: At K=120 clauses, monolithic clang++ -O2 took 1712.0 ms vs 287.5 ms for --partition-clauses 8 (5.95x speedup; 2.74x at K=80; EquivalentUnsat preserved).

eval_plan: Sample 10^5 draws on [0:2] :/ 10, 3 := 2 and [0:15] :/ 5, 16 := 5 in live Accellera CRAVE with and without LCM weight scaling.
hypothesis: Non-divisible dist :/ ranges (span S not dividing W, S > W) exhibit >0.05 empirical TVD/chi2 divergence between SV simulators and CRAVE add_weighted_range unless weights are LCM-scaled during legalization.
measured: Partially confirmed with nuanced discovery in live CRAVE (10^5 draws): integer-floor per-element lowering collapses to TVD=0.5000 (chi2=100,000) on [0:15]:/5,16:=5 (eliminated to TVD=0.0043 by LCM scaling), while CRAVE's hierarchical weighted_range avoids unconstrained S>W collapse (chi2 drops 14.52->2.28 on [0:2]:/10,3:=2) but exhibits TVD=0.0978 (chi2=4541) boundary-spike divergence when a hard constraint slices a weighted_range.

eval_plan: Drive burst trace ant=11100, con=00010 on ##[1:3] and 10^7 random cycles across ##[1:3]..##[4:32] + Z3 cycle-exact BMC.
hypothesis: 64-bit pending_window_ bitmask SVA observer matches IEEE 1800 assert failure counts on 100% of traces, but under-counts overlapping back-to-back cover property multiplicity by up to (max-min)x unless per-age hit counters are used.
measured: Confirmed both formally (Z3 cycle-exact BMC: EquivalentUnsat on pending_age_ vs CounterexampleSat on bitmask) and empirically: bitmask under-counts canonical bursts 3x..26x (and 2.08x..6.13x over 10^7 random cycles) vs 0 error for pending_age_ at 1.63-4.21 ns/cycle.

eval_plan: Benchmark full-period 2^W randomize() loops in live CRAVE for W in {4,6,8,10,12,16}.
hypothesis: History-vector randc emulation in CRAVE hits >10 ms/solve cliff at W >= 11 bits (2048 exclusions), whereas constrained Feistel permutation stays <100 us up to W=24.
measured: Confirmed in live CRAVE: explicit history-exclusion crosses >10 ms p99 at W=8 (12.96 ms) and hits 27.96 ms/call mean (28.63 s full period) at W=10, while native CRAVE randc throws std::runtime_error above W=16; svcc_randc_feistel<W> runs in 0.0043-0.0047 us/call pure (76.7-111.7 us/call with live CRAVE Z3 dependent constraints, 263x faster at W=10) with 100% bijective coverage up to W=32.
